title: Gloria Patatas potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Gloria Patatas potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Gloria Patatas potato is a potato variety. 120 to 150 days to harvest, 22.4 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: Gloria Patatas is a registered potato variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2007 as NSIC 2007 Po 09. It takes 120 to 150 days from planting to harvest, with 22.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 120 to 150 days from planting to harvest.
**Yield:** 22.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about Gloria Patatas potato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Gloria Patatas potato takes 120 to 150 days from planting to harvest. That is 31.5 days longer than the average of the 11 potato varieties with a day count, 103.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 22.4 t/ha matches the average of its group, 21.79. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [late blight](/diseases/late-blight).

The pests and diseases that hit potato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its roots have yellow flesh and yellow skin. Dry matter is 19.9 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne.
Where and when to plant Gloria Patatas potato

Potato grows in the cool highlands of Benguet, Mountain Province and Bukidnon. Plant clean seed tubers, and pick a variety rated against late blight for the wet season. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for root crops](/land-preparation/root-crop-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 120 to 150 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 22.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Gloria Patatas?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
